caseName: Zicarelli v. New Jersey State Commission of Investigation
caseNameFull: Zicarelli v. New Jersey State Commission of Investigation

opinions.text:
Appeal from Sup. Ct. N. J. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 401 U. S. 933.] Motion of National District Attorneys Assn. et al. for leave to participate in oral argument as amici curiae denied.

Mr. Justice Brennan took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
